name: @stonedogcode/slack-notify
description: Post a deploy summary to Slack — or to the console when no token is configured.
author: StoneDogCode

scripts.gate: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.//publish:slack-notify: Publish to npm, end to end. Run from a terminal, interactively — npm prompts for the 2FA one-time password and the browser login needs a human, so this is a script you run rather than a CI step.
